title: Read only the records an operation needs

facts.note: Role (PLT-84), mapped to paths by the structure profile.
The task reads from a collection that grows over time.
Diff loads a whole collection and filters or sorts it in memory on a request path.

fires: A request loads every record of an owner, including expired or consumed ones, to use a few.
A write path rewrites records it did not change.
doesNotFire: Batch or reporting jobs that must visit everything.

given: A request-path operation uses a subset of a collection that grows with history
when: the agent writes the read or write of that collection
then: Fetch and write only the records the operation needs, through a store-level query or index, so cost does not grow with history.
prefer: Add a narrow store method (by owner and state, ordered, limited) in the integration role.
A test or counter on a large history showing the number of records touched stays proportional to the records used.
avoid: Adding a cache to hide an unbounded read.
why: Full scans pass every functional test and degrade with each customer's history, until the request path times out.
evidence: Store calls and records touched per request do not grow with unrelated history.
